_comment: Lens system — see docs/design/lens-system-and-evolutions-proposal.md (canonical) + lens-system-addendum-2026-07-27.md. Layer 3 of the character model (Primary locked / Secondary job / Lens). struktured ruling 2026-07-27: Lenses are POOLED — crafted into shared inventory, equippable by ANY party member, never bound to a killer. Acquisition is: defeat a masterite of this axis -> recipe unlocks -> gather materials -> craft -> equip.
_stat_mod_vocabulary: stat_mods keys match PassiveSystem.get_passive_mods exactly (attack_multiplier, defense_multiplier, magic_defense_multiplier, magic_multiplier, speed_multiplier, max_hp_multiplier, max_mp_multiplier, mp_cost_multiplier, healing_multiplier, crit_chance, evasion). Multipliers compose multiplicatively; crit_chance/evasion add. A key needs BOTH LensSystem.NEUTRAL_MODS and get_passive_mods' seed dict: _compose_lens_mods drops anything the seed lacks, so a lens key absent from either is inert while the SAME key on a passive works (_compose_mod creates _multiplier keys). magic_defense_multiplier was missing from both, so no lens could tilt magic defence at all. @cowir-adhoc enumerated the whole chain and it is FOUR gates, not two: (1) NEUTRAL_MODS, which drops an unknown key LOUDLY via push_warning; (2) get_passive_mods' total_mods seed, which _compose_lens_mods consults and which drops SILENTLY -- so a half-fix would have shipped with no warning and no effect; (3) Combatant.MODDABLE_STATS, invisible to any grep because recalculate_stats composes the key at runtime as stat + '_multiplier', which is why magic_defense_multiplier appears nowhere in Combatant.gd except a comment -- and all three apply-blocks (secondary job, passive, equipment) are driven off that one list, so they cannot drift apart; (4) is_magical at the damage site, where a physical hit never consults magic_defense at all. ⚠️ And a lens is pooled AND EXCLUSIVE: equip_lens TRANSFERS, erasing the previous holder, so this tilt protects ONE character against attacks that hit the whole party. The justification first shipped here was WRONG and @cowir-adhoc measured it at .745: no masterite warden deals AoE magic (the AoE, masterite_endurance_test, is PHYSICAL; the magic, masterite_judgment, is single_enemy), and masterite_warden_medieval -- the first warden a player meets -- has no magic ability at all, so the magic half is inert against it. The tilt earns its place because lenses are POOLED and equippable by anyone in any fight: the four W1 dragons carry 2-3 AoE magic abilities each and Mordaine and the Calibrant carry 4, which is where a party actually dies. Of the four bosses called walls, optimization_itself has NO AoE magic, so 'every wall boss deals AoE magic' was false as written. Lenses are deliberately NOT stored in passives.json: they keep a craft-gated inventory and their own equip surface rather than riding AbilitiesMenu's learned_passives list.
_axis_fingerprint: Stat tilts here follow cowir-battle's measurement of what the 20 live masterites ACTUALLY do (msg 3178), not the original doc's sketch. Two of the doc's four tilts were derived from ability TYPE and mislead: Tempo's abilities are 20/25 support (haste/slow/time_tax) so +SPD is the stat it MANIPULATES, not its identity; Curator's 'magic' is mana_drain/audit/dispel/resource_cut, which attack resources rather than HP, so +MAG misreads it. For those two the passive carries the identity and the stat tilt is deliberately absent.

warden.name: Warden Lens
warden.description: You have been hit by something that did not intend to stop. Now neither do you.
warden.flavor: The Warden does not out-damage you. It outlasts you, and then it punishes.
warden.passive_description: Survive one otherwise-lethal blow per battle at 1 HP.

arbiter.name: Arbiter Lens
arbiter.description: A verdict is not louder than an argument. It is only final.
arbiter.flavor: The Arbiter carries the highest physical share of any axis, and its execution ability triples against the wounded.
arbiter.passive_description: Deal +50% damage to enemies below 25% HP.

tempo.name: Tempo Lens
tempo.description: Speed was never the point. The point was whose turn it is.
tempo.flavor: 20 of Tempo's 25 ability slots are support — haste, slow, time tax. It manipulates the action economy; it barely fights.
tempo.passive_description: When you act, the next ally action this round costs 1 less AP.

curator.name: Curator Lens
curator.description: It is not taking your life. It is taking your options, and keeping a record.
curator.flavor: Every Curator 'magic' ability is a resource attack wearing damage clothing — mana drain, audit, dispel, resource cut.
curator.passive_description: Gain 1 MP whenever a party member spends MP. Debuffs land 25% less often on you.
